name: Mini Doubt: Gouka Kyakusen Hen
original_name: ミニダウト 豪華客船編
source:
A new Doubt story with a shorter duration that adds randomization to the mix!

Our protagonist is the granddaughter of the president of a small European country. She was forced by her parents to introduce them to his boyfriend during a luxury cruise, but he ran away with his secret lover just before boarding! Our heroine will have to choose between six famous and handsome men to introduce as her boyfriend, but these men hide secrets... and it's up to her to uncover them!
translation:
持续时间较短的新《怀疑》故事增加了随机性！

我们的主角是欧洲一个小国总统的孙女。她在豪华游轮上被父母强迫介绍给男友，男友却在上船前带着秘密情人跑了！我们的女主角必须在六位著名且英俊的男人中进行选择作为她的男朋友，但这些男人隐藏着秘密……而她必须揭开这些秘密！
